basic_details.job_title: Madras University Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Madras University has released the official Guest Lecturer Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.unom.ac.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the Madras University Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates with a Postgraduate degree in Materials Science or Physics and a Ph.D. in the relevant subject area can apply. Interested candidates can submit their offline applications on or before 04 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application form are available below.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Lecturer position at Madras University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Lecturer position at Madras University is 04 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Materials Science or Physics, along with a Ph.D. in the relevant subject area to be eligible for the Guest Lecturer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Guest Lecturer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Guest Lecturer recruitment at Madras University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Lecturer position at Madras University will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. In which mode should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications for the Guest Lecturer position at Madras University must be submitted in offline mode, likely through post as per the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Guest Lecturer position at Madras University is a contractual job, offering a fixed-term engagement.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Madras University located?
faq.answer: Madras University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Lecturer post in this recruitment drive by Madras University.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not explicitly restrict applications from outside Tamil Nadu. However, candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and are prepared to work in Chennai.
